items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 87:1
items.html: Since there were three partners in the ZAT of Nekudim in the emanation of ZON, which are the ZAT of Nekudim: the NHY of AK and the NHY of AVI. Hence, they are joined together in the phase of AHP, which are: the AHP of Keter of Atzilut, which are Atik and AA, which are the phase of the inner NHY of AK, which is also the Partzuf of the Keter of AK. And the AHP of AVI and Yashsut, which are returned to a single Partzuf, are in the place of the AVI of Nekudim at the time of their Gadlut.
